name: nexus-starship-guardians
description: Project-scoped Guardian operations, Intelligence Fabric planning, fingerprinted fixed-corpus evaluation, approvals, integration readiness guidance, and verified runtime workflows for Nexus Starship Guardians.

interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, evaluate, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. Supports Intelligence Fabric strategy planning, Guardian Intelligence Lab fixed-corpus baseline/candidate evaluation, live mission classification, capability mapping, permission-safe Guardian routing, project onboarding, bounded Guardian runs through the compatible REST v1 API, explicit approval review, integration readiness checks, and evidence-first verification. The package includes a small optional REST CLI for an existing authorized Nexus endpoint. It does not bundle a hosted model, credentials, or an MCP server, and it never grants filesystem, GitHub, deployment, browser, or infrastructure permissions by itself.
capabilities: Plan missions with explicit strategy, uncertainty, adversarial checks, capabilities, and tool requirements
Evaluate baseline and candidate Guardian strategies against fingerprinted fixed corpora
Plan isolated Nexus projects and Guardian permissions
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks
Assess Lucio, Ember, Nexus Code, Railway, and Supabase integration readiness
Audit verification, tenant isolation, and production readiness
defaultPrompt: Build an Intelligence Fabric plan for this mission and show strategy, uncertainty, evidence, and adversarial checks.
Compare a baseline and candidate using the Guardian Intelligence Lab fixed corpus and show the promotion evidence.
Inspect my Nexus run and explain any pending approvals.
Review whether this Nexus integration has enough evidence for release.
